description: Contract for a future public developer sandbox token. The current repository only defines the contract and local checks; it does not store or issue real sandbox tokens.
privacyBoundary: Do not store real token values, secrets, account identifiers, production URLs, webhook secrets, DSNs or user data in this repository.

rateLimitPolicy.evidenceRequiredBeforeLive: external sandbox gateway or API rate-limit smoke

negativeRules: Local FATE_API_TOKEN or scoped user token cannot be used as sandbox token live evidence.
Placeholder token strings cannot be committed as proof.
Docs smoke cannot be reported as token issuance evidence.
